post.description:
Scrapes the 50 newest Play Store reviews for the configured app, keeps only 4- and 5-star entries, upserts them into PlatformReview by external id and enforces the stored-review cap.

**Notes:** Uses google-play-scraper against PLAY_STORE_APP_ID. Reads no request body. Runs enforceReviewLimit('PLAY_STORE') which can delete older stored reviews.

_Source: `app/api/reviews/fetch-playstore/route.ts`_

_Auth: `pabbly-secret`_

example.message: Processed 22 Play Store reviews (7 new, 15 updated)

500.description: PLAY_STORE_APP_ID not configured or scrape failure

get.description:
Paginated admin view of stored platform reviews with platform, rating, visibility and text search filters.

_Source: `app/api/reviews/platform/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

patch.description:
Shows or hides a stored platform review, which controls whether it appears on the public reviews feed.

**Notes:** Affects the public /api/public/reviews feed. Wrapped in withAuditLog (PLATFORM_REVIEW).

_Source: `app/api/reviews/platform/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

post.summary: Ingest a platform review via webhook
post.description:
Upserts a single external review (Google My Business, App Store or Play Store) into PlatformReview keyed on externalReviewId. Only 4- and 5-star ratings are accepted; word ratings such as FIVE are mapped to numbers.

**Notes:** Ingested reviews are created with isVisible=true, so they appear immediately on the public /api/public/reviews feed. Runs enforceReviewLimit for the platform, which can delete older stored reviews.

_Source: `app/api/reviews/platform-webhook/route.ts`_

_Auth: `pabbly-secret`_

get.description:
Returns every review left on the order, enriched with the reviewer's and reviewed party's name and contact details resolved from the Customers, Vendors or Cashboy tables.

**Notes:** Response includes reviewer email and phone — treat as PII.

_Source: `app/api/reviews/[leadId]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

isVisible.description: Must be a boolean; anything else 400s

rating.description: 4 or 5, as a number or one of FOUR/FIVE

reviewImages.description: Image URLs; non-arrays are coerced to []

reviewDate.description: Review date, parsed with new Date()

externalReviewId.description: Upsert key from the source platform

ErrorDetailsListEnvelope.description: Validation error envelope `{ error, details[] }`; `details` lists the individual field problems.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
